After preprocessing, fiber orientation distributions (FODs) were estimated for each subject using the Multi-Shell Multi-Tissue Constrained Spherical Deconvolution (MSMT-CSD) algorithm (Jeurissen et al., 2014) using group averaged response functions for white matter, grey matter, and CSF (Dhollander et al., 2016). Next, anatomical images were co-registered to averaged b0 using FLIRT toolbox of FSL. Analysis of five million streamlines was performed over the entire brain through probabilistic tractography, which was implemented in the MRtrix. The cortex parcellation with 7 networks for each hemisphere (200 parcels) (Schaefer et al., 2018) was used to generate the structural connectome including the default mode network (DMN; 27 nodes), the limbic network (6 nodes), the visual network (14 nodes), the somatomotor network (SMN;16 nodes), the frontoparietal network (13 nodes), the dorsal attention network (DAN; 13 nodes), and the ventral attention network (VAN; 11 nodes) (supplementary Table 1). For each participant, 214 × 214 connectivity matrices were derived using the number of streamlines connecting between each pair of regions, where 214 is the total number of nodes. "你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。\n判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，\n也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。\n\n历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；\n没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，\n不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。\n字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{\"selected_experience_ids\":[],\"selection_reasons\":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。\n严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{\"selected_experience_ids\": \\\"Preprocessing of diffusion-weighted images included: denoising the data (Veraart et al., 2016) using MRtrix3 , correction of EPI distortions (Holland et al., 2010), correction for motion and eddy-current distortions (Andersson and Sotiropoulos, 2016) using FSL , and bias field correction (Tustison et al., 2010) using ANTs . After preprocessing, fiber orientation distributions (FODs) were estimated for each subject using the Multi-Shell Multi-Tissue Constrained Spherical Deconvolution (MSMT-CSD) algorithm (Jeurissen et al., 2014) using group averaged response functions for white matter, grey matter, and CSF (Dhollander et al., 2016). To create a whole-brain tractogram using Anatomically Constrained Tractography (ACT) algorithm, tissue classification for 5 different tissue types (cortical gray matter, subcortical gray matter, white matter, CSF and pathological tissue) were generated from the anatomical data. Next, anatomical images were co-registered to averaged b0 using FLIRT toolbox of FSL. Analysis of five million streamlines was performed over the entire brain through probabilistic tractography, which was implemented in the MRtrix. The cortex parcellation with 7 networks for each hemisphere (200 parcels) (Schaefer et al., 2018) was used to generate the structural connectome including the default mode network (DMN; 27 nodes), the limbic network (6 nodes), the visual network (14 nodes), the somatomotor network (SMN;16 nodes), the frontoparietal network (13 nodes), the dorsal attention network (DAN; 13 nodes), and the ventral attention network (VAN; 11 nodes) (supplementary Table 1). We added 14 subcortical areas to the atlas using the FIRST command in FSL software. For each participant, 214 × 214 connectivity matrices were derived using the number of streamlines connecting between each pair of regions, where 214 is the total number of nodes. The COMMIT2 algorithm was then applied to remove false positive streamlines and filter the raw connectome. Finally, the raw and COMMIT-weighted connectomes were constructed for each subject\\\" and add these sentences to it :In this study, we utilized a methodology for generating the structural connectome and constructing tractography-based connectomes using diffusion-weighted images (DWIs) in MRtrix. The basic principle for generating the structural connectome involved first preprocessing the DWIs to correct any distortions and register them to the anatomical image. Next, we performed tractography using the MRtrix software to create fiber streamlines in the brain. These streamlines represent the white matter pathways connecting different regions of the brain. From these streamlines, we calculated the connectivity matrix, which provides information on the strength and directionality of the connections between different brain regions.
